assumptions: flowVS: the files hold the same populations, so their peaks should share a variance.
flowTrans: the chosen channels are jointly normal after the right transform.
limits: flowVS chooses one cofactor per channel; flowTrans one parameter set for all its channels.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which transform parameters does this data itself support?

description: Choose the transform from the data. flowVS: the asinh(x / c) cofactor of one channel that makes its density peaks' variances most alike across project FCS files (Bartlett's statistic, Brent search over e^-1..e^10). flowTrans: the arcsinh, Box-Cox, linlog or biexponential parameters that make two or more channels of one file most jointly normal (profile likelihood, L-BFGS-B).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

channels.description: flowtrans: two or more channels, comma-separated.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

population.description: a population, gated in every file; empty for all.

sample_files.description: flowvs: project FCS files, comma-separated; empty for all.

name: estimate_flow_cytometry_scale

flowtrans.description: the fitted parameters, objective, convergence and the transform they define; null for flowVS

flowvs.description: the search (window optima, local cofactors) and each file’s peaks at the cofactor; null for flowTrans

scale_params.description: the fit as analyze_flow_cytometry's `scale` and its parameters (flowVS: arcsinh and the cofactor), to display the data on it
